dc.title: Derivation of the Entropy Production Function Γ(ρ) from Grid-Mode Bose–Einstein Statistics
dc.creator: Morten Magnusson
dc.subject: entropy production function
Bose-Einstein statistics
von Neumann entropy
grid modes
micro-to-macro bridge
EFC
cosmology
dc.description: First derivation of Γ(ρ) from BE statistics + von Neumann entropy. Result: Γ ∝ ρ^(3/2)/(ρ+ρ_crit) with emergent ρ_crit = a₀/(G_N l_g). Scenario B: correct qualitative structure, exponent 3/2 vs phenomenological 1. Double-counting μ_BE vs Γ resolved.
